faqs.a:
(a)
Except where this article provides otherwise, the provisions of article V of chapter
               2 of this Code shall govern the conduct of any administrative hearing conducted in
               accordance with this article.
(b)
The hearing notice shall be sent by first class mail addressed to the property owner
               at the address given the city by the owner pursuant to
section 38-193
(5).
(c)
The administrative hearing shall be held within 14 days of receipt of the property
               owner's request for hearing.
(d)
At the hearing, the city manager or his designee, shall hear such statements and consider
               such evidence as the property owner, code enforcement officer, other party in interest,
               or other witness shall offer relative to the existence of and removal or elimination
               of graffiti on the affected property.
(e)
The city manager, or his designee, shall make findings of fact from the statements
               and evidence offered as to whether graffiti exists and whether it should be removed
               or eliminated. If the city manager, or his designee, determines that graffiti exists
               and should be removed or eliminated, he shall issue an order based on the findings
               of fact made pursuant herewith commanding the property owner to remove or eliminate
               the causes of graffiti.
(f)
If an order issued by the city manager, or his designee, pursuant to subsection (e)
               of this section has not been complied with within 30 days after its issuance, the
               city, at the direction of the city manager, or his designee, may cause the elimination
               or removal of the causes of graffiti.
(g)
Any such owner who fails to comply with an order issued by the city manager, or his
               designee, pursuant to subsection (e) of this section, shall be charged with all administrative
               costs and expenses incurred in the elimination or removal of the causes of graffiti.
               Such administrative costs shall include the cost of said removal or elimination, inspection
               fees, postal charges, legal expenses, and other expenses as ascertained by the city
               manager, or his designee, which are the result of the enforcement of this article.
               Imposition of costs are independent of any other powers of the city as set forth anywhere
               in this Code.
(Code 1981, § 20-53; Ord. No. 3455, § 3, 7-6-1998)
